sections.content: You know these stems from the future (Unit 19). Verbs that are irregular in the future tense use the exact same stem in the conditional tense, with regular conditional endings (-ía, -ías, -ía, -íamos, -íais, -ían):

sections.title: Core Irregular Conditional Stems
rows: podría, podrías, podría (could / would be able)

items.english: Could you help me with this suitcase?

items.spanish: Yo no haría eso en tu lugar.
items.english: I wouldn't do that in your place.
What would you say in my place?
